claims: Ask ChatGPT or Claude to recommend a business in your niche and it names about 3 sites; if you are not one you don't exist
Barely anyone, including huge companies, is optimizing for GEO yet; big brands' sites are bloated and slow to change
On-screen stat: ~93% of AI searches end without a click (source Semrush, 2026)
He optimized his whole site in one afternoon with a free Claude plugin and saw a big increase in Google Search Console appearances

Install the Claude SEO skill in Claude Code (public open-source version)
Run its audit; it produces a prioritized action plan with falsifiable recommendations grounded in Google guidance
Apply the structural/schema/content fixes across the site in one session
Watch Google Search Console for increased AI-search appearances; full step-by-step on his YouTube

relevance.why: Directly relevant to a founder shipping apps and landing pages: being the site an LLM recommends is cheap distribution right now. A packaged Claude Code SEO/GEO skill with schema and citability scoring is exactly the kind of leverage a time-poor solo founder can run in an afternoon across all his sites.

implement_score.why: Install the public claude-seo skill, run the audit on each app's marketing site, apply schema.org/FAQ/citability fixes, track in Search Console. A few hours per site. Need to verify the repo name and that the 'public' version is not a crippled funnel for the paid community.
